name: Straight Hair
description: Straight hair is typically smooth and uniform in texture, with a straight shape that lies flat against the head without much curl or wave. It generally has fewer cuticles compared to curly or wavy hair types.
characteristics: Tends to be less prone to frizz
Easier to style with straightening tools
common_problems: Increased dryness due to lower sebum production
Susceptibility to heat damage from styling tools
More prone to breakage if not properly conditioned
recommended_ingredients: Hydrating oils like argan or avocado oil
Protein treatments for strength and elasticity
ingredients_to_avoid: Harsh sulfates that strip natural oils
Alcohol-based products that can be drying
High heat styling tools without proper protection
oil_recommendation: Apply a small amount of oil to the ends before heat styling or as a leave-in treatment for added moisture.

morning_routine.action: Gently massage a hydrating conditioner into the hair and scalp, focusing on the mid-lengths and ends.
morning_routine.purpose: To moisturize and detangle the hair.

night_routine.action: Apply a lightweight leave-in conditioner or oil mist to damp hair before styling or sleeping.
night_routine.purpose: To retain moisture overnight and prevent dryness.

weekly_care: Deep condition at least once a week using a hydrating mask or deep conditioning treatment.
heat_styling_recommendation: Use heat protectant spray before styling with hot tools and limit the use of straighteners, curlers, or irons.
lifestyle_tips: Stay well-hydrated to maintain internal moisture balance.
Protect hair from harsh environmental conditions like wind or cold.
foods_for_healthy_hair: Protein-rich foods like chicken and fish
Fruits and vegetables with high water content
Omega-3 rich foods such as flaxseeds
common_mistakes: Over-washing the hair, which can strip natural oils.
Ignoring hydration needs by using only heavy products.
dont: Do not skip moisturizing steps in your routine.
Do not use extremely high heat without protection.

seasonal_care.summer: Use lightweight, water-based products to keep hair cool and dry.
seasonal_care.winter: Focus on deep conditioning to counteract cold weather's drying effects.
seasonal_care.monsoon: Maintain consistent moisture levels by applying oils and conditioners more frequently.

expert_tips: Regular trims can help maintain the length of straight hair, reducing split ends.
Experiment with different styling techniques to find what works best for your specific texture.
